geometryBasis: Mapped outline and the Historic American Buildings Survey set the original masonry body and polygonal south room. Two exact March 2010 exterior photographs establish the cream wraparound veranda, tall paired upper windows, eave brackets and roof silhouette.
sectionBasis: The survey supplies the main body dimensions of 46 by 40 feet, 9-foot veranda width, 12-foot-6 veranda height, opening sizes and three brick chimneys. Heights above the veranda, roof pitches, column spacing, and unseen rear details are estimates.
